description: Inventory of the current sample files, with counts measured using the real GEOS WASM engine and the specified configuration.
issueCounting: Count record diagnostics, attribute issues, identity issues and topology findings by built-in rule. Count file or configuration rejection once. A diagnostic can belong to multiple rules. These observations describe fixtures; independent hand-authored validation cases remain the correctness reference.
